x: The great Emil Zatopek who had in a small way contributed to my own downfall by running, in my humble opinion, far faster than was necessary in our heat, was matched against, among others, Gaston Reiff from Belgium.

His time was the second best ever, coupled with the defeat of such great athletes as Gaston Reiff, Emil Zatopek, Viljo Heino and Slykhuis. The surprise win for Great Britain was Jack Archer in the 100 metres.

Mal Whitfield retained the US grip on the 800m by holding off Arthur Wint in a close finish and the day ended with Emil Zatopek just failing to catch Gaston Reiff of Belgium in monsoon-like conditions in the 5,000m, after appearing well beaten.
The 5,000 metres final was eagerly awaited by the home crowd supporting their hero Gaston Reiff, the Olympic Champion renewing his Olympic battle with Emil Zatopek.
